title: Verify a Processing Fee reaches a new work order via location auto-apply
custom_preconds: 1. A Processing Fee template "ZZAUTOTEST Proc Fee" (Flat Amount $5.00, taxable Yes) is marked auto-apply.
custom_steps:
1. Create a new work order at that location.
2. Open the 'Work Order Fees & Discounts' card.
custom_expected:
1. The new work order carries a whole-work-order Processing Fee.
2. In its ⋮ menu, 'Remove' works but 'Edit' does nothing for a Processing Fee.
